title: CORE-6963 · [RF] / — FAQ caret icon doesn't rotate/animate on open (Key questions accordion)
body:
Linear: https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-6963/rf-faq-caret-icon-doesnt-rotateanimate-on-open-key-questions-accordion

(Reference only — the ticket is the source of truth; fetch the live description at implement time.)
acceptanceCriteria: On the homepage "Key questions about forming a company" FAQ accordion, clicking a closed question opens it AND the caret/chevron icon visibly rotates with a smooth CSS transition (not an instant snap) — matching Live's `transition: all 0.35s ease` timing.
Clicking an open question closes it AND the caret rotates back with the same smooth transition (not instant).

The caret element itself has a non-zero, non-'none' `transition`/`transform` computed style difference between the collapsed and expanded (aria-expanded=true) states — i.e. it is not `transition-duration: 0s` / `transform: none` in both states as on the buggy clone.
Behaviour verified with a REAL click (not a CSS/DOM read) at all four breakpoints: 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800 — collapsed screenshot AND open screenshot captured at each, showing the rotated indicator.
No visual regressions to the FAQ accordion block's layout/spacing/position (whole-block coordinate check passes at 360/768/1024/1800).
